requirements.title: Interleaved epoch evaluation
requirements.statement: The public evaluator MUST evaluate accepted parent epoch state before validating child controls.
requirements.acceptance: A signed scenario proves a statically valid but state-invalid lower-ID child cannot defeat a valid sibling.

requirements.title: Stateful candidate classification
requirements.statement: Every child control MUST receive valid, pending, or invalid classification from the authoritative path.
requirements.acceptance: The public report includes distinct control dispositions for all child candidates.

requirements.title: Valid-only selection
requirements.statement: Only valid child controls participate in lowest-EventId selection.
requirements.acceptance: Permutation tests produce the same selected child and dispositions.

requirements.title: Account continuity
requirements.statement: Retained device account mappings MUST remain immutable.
requirements.acceptance: A signed changed-account child is invalid.

requirements.title: Role monotonicity
requirements.statement: Retained devices MUST NOT gain roles in a descendant control.
requirements.acceptance: A signed role-escalation child is invalid.

requirements.title: No reintroduction
requirements.statement: A removed device key MUST NOT reappear in later control ancestry.
requirements.acceptance: A signed remove-then-reintroduce scenario is invalid.

requirements.title: Terminal continuity
requirements.statement: Terminal controls MUST NOT have ordinary children.
requirements.acceptance: A signed terminal-child scenario is invalid.

requirements.title: Successor continuity
requirements.statement: Successor/predecessor links MUST be reciprocal and exact.
requirements.acceptance: Valid and invalid signed successor scenarios pass expected dispositions.

requirements.title: Retained writer frontier
requirements.statement: A child MUST retain each retained writer's highest accepted parent contribution in its base closure.
requirements.acceptance: A child omitting a retained contribution is invalid.

requirements.title: Late evidence recomputation
requirements.statement: New evidence that may change child classification or selection MUST trigger deterministic genesis replay.
requirements.acceptance: Late valid and invalid lower-ID sibling tests pass.

requirements.title: Frontier/closure separation
requirements.statement: The implementation MUST represent control frontier separately from its exact accepted ancestor closure.
requirements.acceptance: A chain A<-B with base_heads=[B] carries both A and B into the next epoch.

requirements.title: Missing closure pending
requirements.statement: A control with incomplete frontier closure MUST remain pending.
requirements.acceptance: Delivery of the missing dependency deterministically promotes the control.

requirements.title: Parent exclusion
requirements.statement: Accepted parent changes outside a selected child base closure MUST become excluded in the child epoch.
requirements.acceptance: A branched parent history yields the exact child closure and report.

requirements.title: Accepted-at-control snapshots
requirements.statement: The evaluator MUST retain exact accepted closure at every canonical control.
requirements.acceptance: Checkpoint history verification uses the same accepted-at-control set.

requirements.title: Base actor state
requirements.statement: Actor states MUST be reconstructed from the exact accepted epoch base.
requirements.acceptance: A multi-epoch actor sequence continues without reset.

requirements.title: Exact sequence
requirements.statement: New changes MUST use the exact next actor sequence.
requirements.acceptance: Gap, rollback, replay, and missing predecessor scenarios are invalid.

requirements.title: Exact operation counter
requirements.statement: start_op MUST equal actor next_op and nonempty changes MUST advance it with checked arithmetic.
requirements.acceptance: Wrong start_op and overflow vectors are invalid.

requirements.title: Empty change counters
requirements.statement: An empty change consumes sequence without advancing next_op.
requirements.acceptance: Cross-language empty-change vector agrees.

requirements.title: Empty change frontier
requirements.statement: An empty change's dependencies MUST equal the current accepted heads.
requirements.acceptance: Wrong fan-in is invalid.

requirements.title: Base ancestry
requirements.statement: Every control base head MUST be in a candidate's dependency closure before acceptance.
requirements.acceptance: Complete evidence with omitted base head is invalid, not pending.

requirements.title: Missing dependencies
requirements.statement: Absent dependencies MUST produce pending rather than invalid.
requirements.acceptance: Late dependency promotes the candidate deterministically.

requirements.title: Exact closure application
requirements.statement: Each candidate MUST apply to exactly its accepted dependency closure.
requirements.acceptance: A candidate that applies only against a larger unrelated document is invalid.

requirements.title: Candidate-local failure
requirements.statement: A change application failure MUST invalidate that candidate without fabricating complete document failure.
requirements.acceptance: Other independent valid candidates remain evaluable.

requirements.title: Fixpoint
requirements.statement: Candidate dispositions MUST be recomputed until stable.
requirements.acceptance: Seeded order permutations converge.

requirements.title: Base-aware equivocation
requirements.statement: Equivocation detection MUST include sequences represented in the accepted base.
requirements.acceptance: A repeated base sequence is invalid/quarantined as specified.

requirements.title: Descendant quarantine
requirements.statement: First conflicting sequence, later same-actor changes, and transitive dependants MUST be excluded.
requirements.acceptance: Cross-actor dependant fixture reports the exact affected set.

requirements.title: Duplicate carrier safety
requirements.statement: Multiple identical valid carriers MUST NOT constitute equivocation.
requirements.acceptance: Duplicate-heavy fixture leaves state unchanged.

requirements.title: Namespaced dispositions
requirements.statement: Reports MUST include canonical control, change, and signed-event disposition records.
requirements.acceptance: Digest vectors include all applicable namespaces.

requirements.title: Distinct invalid and excluded
requirements.statement: Invalid and excluded collections MUST remain distinct.
requirements.acceptance: A scenario containing both produces disjoint lists.

requirements.title: Dynamic control dispositions
requirements.statement: State-invalid controls MUST be reported as invalid despite static carrier validity.
requirements.acceptance: Signed invalid child appears as control_event/invalid.

requirements.title: Canonical completion
requirements.statement: Canonical completion MUST be complete, budget_exhausted, or cancelled only.
requirements.acceptance: Report schema rejects failed.

requirements.title: Typed evaluation errors
requirements.statement: Unexpected invariant/adapter failure MUST be returned as a typed noncanonical error.
requirements.acceptance: Public API tests distinguish Err from incomplete reports.

requirements.title: Digest alignment
requirements.statement: The public evaluator and conformance runner MUST use one digest implementation.
requirements.acceptance: No duplicate normative digest implementation remains.

requirements.title: Raw invalid evidence
requirements.statement: Invalid raw bytes without EventId MUST remain evidence-only for draft v1.
requirements.acceptance: They are absent from canonical disposition digest but visible in evidence records.

requirements.title: Required tag cardinality
requirements.statement: Required tags MUST remain exactly once with exact element count.
requirements.acceptance: Positive and negative signed fixtures pass.

requirements.title: Unknown tag tolerance
requirements.statement: Unknown tags MUST be ignored for v1 semantics.
requirements.acceptance: Adding arbitrary unknown tags leaves canonical report bytes unchanged.

requirements.title: Explicit forbidden tags
requirements.statement: Only tags explicitly forbidden by the NIP are rejected solely by name.
requirements.acceptance: expiration and - fail; harmless d/a/e/x extras are ignored where not required.

requirements.title: Strict revision probe
requirements.statement: Revision/profile detection MUST use bounded duplicate-aware parsing.
requirements.acceptance: Duplicate v/format fixtures are invalid.

requirements.title: Unsupported distinction
requirements.statement: Only a unique canonical unknown declaration is unsupported_revision.
requirements.acceptance: Malformed and noncanonical declarations are invalid.

requirements.title: Complete work inventory
requirements.statement: Every untrusted-evidence loop MUST map to a typed work counter.
requirements.acceptance: Static audit and boundary tests cover each loop.

requirements.title: Complete cancellation
requirements.statement: Cancellation MUST be checked at every deterministic algorithm boundary.
requirements.acceptance: Boundary enumeration test cancels safely at each call.

requirements.title: Iterative traversal
requirements.statement: Graph and projection traversal MUST be iterative.
requirements.acceptance: Deep document/graph tests do not recurse.

requirements.title: No evidence panic
requirements.statement: Untrusted evidence MUST NOT reach panic-only assertions.
requirements.acceptance: Mutation/fuzz tests cover prior unreachable paths.

requirements.title: No post-exhaustion work
requirements.statement: No optional checkpoint or projection work occurs after budget exhaustion/cancellation.
requirements.acceptance: Counters and side-effect-free reports prove early stop.

requirements.title: Conflict branch identity
requirements.statement: Nested conflicting object descendants MUST retain unique deterministic branch identity.
requirements.acceptance: Two conflicting maps with the same child key remain distinguishable.

requirements.title: Mark expansion
requirements.statement: Projection MUST preserve Automerge mark expansion semantics.
requirements.acceptance: Every expansion mode has Rust/TypeScript vector coverage.

requirements.title: Unambiguous assertions
requirements.statement: A neutral assertion path MUST resolve to exactly one branch or fail.
requirements.acceptance: The runner rejects ambiguous ordinary paths.

requirements.title: Projection metering
requirements.statement: Projection MUST charge object/property/conflict/text/mark work.
requirements.acceptance: Exact boundary tests pass.

requirements.title: Empty checkpoint
requirements.statement: Zero-change zero-head checkpoints MUST be accepted when all other commitments are valid.
requirements.acceptance: A signed empty-history checkpoint verifies.

requirements.title: Empty change-set hash
requirements.statement: The empty sorted change-set hash MUST have a committed vector.
requirements.acceptance: Rust and TypeScript agree.

requirements.title: Negative matrix execution
requirements.statement: Every checkpoint refusal family MUST execute through signed public-engine evidence.
requirements.acceptance: The generated checkpoint report lists exact fixture IDs and pass results.

requirements.title: Checkpoint non-authority
requirements.statement: Invalid/unauthorized checkpoint evidence MUST NOT alter canonical history.
requirements.acceptance: Baseline and checkpoint-added reports have identical history fields.

requirements.title: Correct canonical dependency
requirements.statement: Checkpoint authorization and accepted-at-control history MUST use the corrected control/epoch engine.
requirements.acceptance: Multi-epoch checkpoint fixture verifies exact closure.

requirements.title: Signed normative inputs
requirements.statement: Normative fixtures MUST use raw signed Nostr events.
requirements.acceptance: Schema rejects abstract valid booleans.

requirements.title: Public engine route
requirements.statement: Every normative Rust fixture MUST use CorpusBuilder and ReferenceEvaluator.
requirements.acceptance: Runner audit finds no alternate semantic evaluator.

requirements.title: Simplified route removal
requirements.statement: The simplified interop evaluator MUST be deleted or marked non-normative and excluded from attestations.
requirements.acceptance: Distribution manifest contains no abstract profile.

requirements.title: Permutation completeness
requirements.statement: Complete scenarios MUST run required delivery permutations.
requirements.acceptance: Canonical output is byte-identical across orders.

requirements.title: Executed proof binding
requirements.statement: Covered requirements MUST bind exact executed result artifacts.
requirements.acceptance: Validator rejects path-only proof.

requirements.title: No default out-of-core
requirements.statement: Applicability MUST come from approved authority data.
requirements.acceptance: Unclassified requirement fails generation.

requirements.title: Artifact hash verification
requirements.statement: Evidence validators MUST verify result SHA-256 and fixture distribution binding.
requirements.acceptance: Tampered result fails.

requirements.title: Final commit binding
requirements.statement: Interop attestation MUST bind final Rust and private TypeScript commits.
requirements.acceptance: The final report contains exact reviewed completion commits.

requirements.title: Same signed corpus
requirements.statement: Both engines MUST consume the same signed fixture distribution.
requirements.acceptance: Manifest hash and profile report hashes match.

requirements.title: Private source boundary
requirements.statement: No private TypeScript source or path may enter the public repository.
requirements.acceptance: Repository policy test passes.

requirements.title: Mismatch detection
requirements.statement: A deliberate report mutation MUST be detected.
requirements.acceptance: Comparator exits nonzero and records expected classification.

requirements.title: Sustained Rust fuzzing
requirements.statement: Sustained native Rust fuzz execution MUST complete before publication readiness.
requirements.acceptance: Trusted result records every target with zero unresolved crash/timeout.

requirements.title: Resource qualification
requirements.statement: Representative resource qualification MUST cover control, graph, projection, and checkpoint workloads.
requirements.acceptance: Accepted report binds final commit and environment.

requirements.title: Independent review
requirements.statement: Independent security and protocol review MUST complete before production or publication readiness.
requirements.acceptance: Signed review report has no unresolved critical/high issue.

requirements.title: Explicit publication authority
requirements.statement: No push, tag, package, or release action occurs without separate authority.
requirements.acceptance: Closure report retains nonclaim until authorization.
